title: 早上七点的浴室
scene:
<|background_setting|>The corridor and kitchen of an old Japanese share house at seven in the morning, pale cold morning light from a high window, worn floorboards, one bathroom door at the end of the corridor, slippers kicked off in front of it, cracked wall paint, a small kitchen sink just off the corridor.<|/background_setting|>
<|layout|>LAYOUT AND STORY: PANEL ONE is the RIGHT panel of the TOP row, the sporty girl hammering on the bathroom door. PANEL TWO is the LEFT panel of the TOP row, the girl with the headphones leaning on the wall brushing her teeth. PANEL THREE is the RIGHT panel of the MIDDLE row, the bathroom door opened a crack with the woman inside. PANEL FOUR is the LEFT panel of the MIDDLE row, the young man standing at the kitchen sink with a toothbrush. PANEL FIVE is the RIGHT panel of the BOTTOM row, an angry close-up of the sporty girl. PANEL SIX is the LEFT panel of the BOTTOM row, the girl with the headphones delivering the last line.<|/layout|>

items.desc: PANEL ONE, the RIGHT panel of the TOP row — the end of the corridor at seven in the morning, the closed bathroom door, slippers kicked off in front of it, pale cold morning light, motion lines around a fist hitting the door
items.note: 第一格：美咲砸浴室门，旁白交代「四个人一个浴室」

items.desc: PANEL TWO, the LEFT panel of the TOP row — the corridor wall beside the bathroom, cracked paint, a bath towel hanging on a hook, cold morning light from a high window
items.note: 第二格：雫靠墙刷牙，报时

items.desc: PANEL THREE, the RIGHT panel of the MIDDLE row — the bathroom door opened just a crack, steam curling out into the corridor, warm light from inside, water droplets on the doorframe
items.note: 第三格：浴室门缝里彩花讨价还价

items.desc: PANEL FOUR, the LEFT panel of the MIDDLE row — the small kitchen sink at the side of the corridor, seen from the side, a cup holding three mismatched toothbrushes behind the tap, some dishes stacked to one side, cold morning light
items.note: 第四格：春站在厨房水池前，拿着牙刷，准备在这儿刷牙

items.desc: PANEL FIVE, the RIGHT panel of the BOTTOM row — the corridor wall behind her, angry comic motion lines radiating, pale morning light
PANEL SIX, the LEFT panel of the BOTTOM row — the corridor by the bathroom door, morning light, a toothbrush cup on the floor beside her feet
CHARACTER FOUR - MISAKI, inside PANEL ONE only, standing at the bathroom door hammering it with one fist, leaning forward, shouting at the door
CHARACTER THREE - SHIZUKU, inside PANEL TWO only, leaning against the corridor wall with a toothbrush in her mouth, arms crossed, eyes half closed and bored
items.note: 第二格里的雫：靠墙刷牙

items.desc: CHARACTER TWO - SAYAKA, inside PANEL THREE only, close-up of her face and one shoulder through the crack of the bathroom door, hair wet and stuck to her cheek, bare shoulder above a bath towel, smug look
items.note: 第三格里的彩花：门缝里露出半张脸，湿发，肩上浴巾

items.desc: CHARACTER ONE - HARU, inside PANEL FOUR only, seen from the side standing at the kitchen sink, holding a toothbrush up in one hand, glancing back toward the corridor
items.note: 第四格里的春：侧身站在厨房水池前，举着牙刷，回头看走廊

items.desc: CHARACTER FOUR - MISAKI, inside PANEL FIVE only, close-up of her face, teeth bared, veins popping, shouting
items.note: 第五格里的美咲：大特写，咬牙

items.desc: CHARACTER THREE - SHIZUKU, inside PANEL SIX only, waist-up, toothbrush still in her mouth, looking straight at the camera with a deadpan face
items.note: 第六格里的雫：半身，牙刷还叼着

items.desc: in the TOP LEFT of PANEL ONE. It is the narrator, not a character speaking.
items.text: 四个人，一个浴室，早上七点。
items.note: 旁白：四个人，一个浴室，早上七点

items.desc: in the TOP CENTRE of PANEL ONE, SPOKEN BY CHARACTER FOUR - MISAKI
in the LEFT of PANEL TWO, SPOKEN BY CHARACTER THREE - SHIZUKU
items.note: 雫：她已经进去二十分钟

items.desc: in the LEFT of PANEL THREE, SPOKEN BY CHARACTER TWO - SAYAKA
in the LEFT of PANEL FOUR, SPOKEN BY CHARACTER ONE - HARU
in the LEFT of PANEL FIVE, SPOKEN BY CHARACTER FOUR - MISAKI
in the LEFT of PANEL SIX, SPOKEN BY CHARACTER THREE - SHIZUKU
